company.name: Emirates Central Cooling Systems Corporation (Empower)
company.shortDescription: Emirates Central Cooling Systems Corporation (Empower) is a Dubai-based district cooling provider.
company.description: Emirates Central Cooling Systems Corporation (EMPOWER) was established in 2003 with an objective to enable the real estate sector to efficiently utilize energy resources through District Cooling Services (DCS).  Empower was set up as a joint venture between Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) and TECOM Investments a member of Dubai Holding through a Royal Decree issued by the Ruler of Dubai.

productsAndServices.description: Centralized production and distribution of chilled water for air-conditioning in residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, and mixed-use developments.
productsAndServices.name: District Cooling Services

productsAndServices.description: Operation, monitoring, and maintenance of district cooling plants, distribution networks, and associated cooling equipment.
productsAndServices.name: District Cooling Plant Operation and Maintenance

productsAndServices.description: Connection of buildings to Empower’s district cooling network and ongoing supply of chilled water for space-conditioning systems.
productsAndServices.name: Chilled Water Supply and Customer Connection Services

productsAndServices.description: Customer account administration, usage measurement, billing, and service support for connected district cooling customers.
